description: Land Acquisition - Koongahagedara, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose (Central Expressway Project), including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and is explicitly labeled as "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices" in the document header.
